description_full: TROOPS, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides consultancy services for insurance products in Hong Kong, Australia, and the People's Republic of China. The company also provides mortgage, personal, and corporate loans; and advisory and referral services in relation to the application of migration, education and visa renewal to its customers. In addition, it is involved in property lease and management; development, operation, and management of an online financial marketplace for financial technology solutions, including API services. The company was formerly known as SGOCO Group, Ltd. and changed its name to TROOPS, Inc. in November 2021. TROOPS, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong.

financial_summary: TROOPS, Inc. is a micro-cap financial services business with a $176M market cap on $17M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +64% over the past three years and +24% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are contracting by -12.9pp, the first warning that competitive pressure is eroding the franchise.

Returns on capital run at -9% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, and 8% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
The business throws off $690,000 in free cash flow — roughly 4 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.

Net dilution runs at 4.9% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 60% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
